name: Kaunertaler Gletscher
kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier up to 3,108 m on the Weißseeferner ice sheet offers an alpine wonderland featuring the barrier-free Falginjochbahn lift, a walk-in ice crevasse, and tri-border vistas.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The magnificent Kaunertal Glacier reposes beneath the glaciated 3,518-metre Weißseespitze pyramid at the head of the pristine Kaunertal Valley, celebrated as Tirol's youngest glacier resort. Ranging from 2,150 to 3,108 metres above sea level across the vast Weißseeferner ice field, this high-alpine domain unveils a primeval landscape of perpetual firn, serrated granite ridges, and glacial moraines. The glacier is internationally acclaimed for barrier-free accessibility: the state-of-the-art Falginjochbahn funifor and Karlesjoch gondola transport wheelchair users and families with strollers effortlessly above 3,100 metres. At the Karlesjoch summit ridge platform, a staggering panoramic tri-border vista unfolds across the Austrian Ötztal Alps, Switzerland's Bernina Range, and Italy's Ortler massif. During summer, the walk-in natural ice crevasse offers visitors a mesmerizing journey into centuries-old glacial ice glowing in deep sapphire hues.

Route & Anforderungen

The trail network branching from the Weißsee glacier center (2,750 m) caters to casual visitors and seasoned mountaineers. An easy, level gravel track leads to the walk-in glacier grotto in roughly 15 minutes of walking. Mountaineers can ascend the rocky crests toward the Falginjoch (3,108 m). Sturdy walking shoes and windproof jackets suffice around the cableway platforms; however, venturing onto moraine slopes or high alpine singletracks strictly requires ankle-high mountain boots with Vibram traction, thermal gloves, and category 4 sunglasses (never enter crevassed glacier ice without a licensed alpine guide).

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via motorway A12 (exit Reschenpass) and highway B180 to Prutz, continuing along the scenic Kaunertal Glacier Road directly to the glacier base at 2,750 metres (abundant complimentary parking). Regional buses run during summer from Landeck and Feichten to the glacier terminal.

Tipps

Do not miss exploring the natural walk-in glacier cave on the Weißseeferner. Stepping into the sculpted ice cavern glowing with subterranean blue light offers an unforgettable glimpse into glacial anatomy.
preis: Glacier plateau accessible; cable car rides and natural walk-in ice cave apply admission
oeffnungszeiten: Summer operations run daily from June through October
